title: Fried Gnocchi with Tomatoes & Olives
description: Gnocchi pan-fried straight from the pack until puffed and golden, then tossed with semi-dried tomatoes, black olives, lemon zest, basil and Parmesan. Fifteen minutes, one pan.

ingredients.note: or other good-quality black olives, pitted
a handful, torn, plus extra to garnish

steps.heading: Bloom
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and add the chilli and garlic. Cook for 1 minute.

steps.heading: Fry the Gnocchi
steps.text: Add the gnocchi and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 7 minutes, until slightly puffed and golden.

steps.heading: Toss
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, olives, lemon zest and basil and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more.

steps.heading: Finish
steps.text: Stir through the Parmesan. Serve drizzled with a little oil and garnished with extra basil leaves.

notes: Traditional Parmesan is made with animal rennet — leave it out, or use a vegetarian hard cheese, for a strictly vegetarian dish.
